name: ac-power-inlet
description: A C14 AC power inlet with three blades.
useCase: Identify the power inlet on a computer, monitor or other device.
misuse: Pair this icon with a visible label when identifying a connection.

16.reason: A wide keyed shroud surrounds three separated blade marks. At least 1px of clear space keeps each blade distinct from the outline.

24.reason: The upper bevels and three blade marks retain the inlet shape, with more than 1.5px of clearance around the blades.
